fixtures.mock_provider: Labelled demo/test double only; never live AI
fixtures.demo_identity: Loopback-only HMAC demo; not OIDC proof
fixtures.http_provider: Local deterministic fixture server in test/provider-http.test.js

ci.release_trigger: workflow_dispatch with explicit version coordinate only
ci.ephemeral_transfer: actions/upload-artifact is CI transfer only, not publication evidence
ci.retained_forge_assets: GitHub Release assets on refs/tags/{version} or refs/tags/v{version} via release/retain-forge-assets.mjs; mismatched tags are refused before forge I/O; identical re-runs are idempotent and changed bytes are refused
ci.canonical_toolchain_enforcement: AITHEMA_CANONICAL_RELEASE=1 on the release workflow; local BSD tar builds remain valid and are not byte-identical to GNU tar

reproducibility.boundary: Published bytes are reproducible under the canonical GNU tar toolchain used by CI. BSD tar may emit different archive bytes for the same tree; local macOS builds are valid for development but are not the publication basis.
reproducibility.timestamp_policy_note: Git-mode uses the committer epoch of the exported commit. Tree-mode reuses provenance.export_mtime_epoch recorded for that current_source_commit. Runtime source.commit is that current commit under frozen aithema-release-manifest/0.1; private_source_commit remains independent lineage in source provenance.

outstanding_coordinator_gates: Create the public GitHub repository inspr-at/aithema (root-owned remote; do not push private history)
Root-owned matching version tag, dispatched forge publication, and downloaded consumer proof
Package registry publication remains unauthorized; this coordinate does not claim the @inspr npm namespace
Configured production identity, live provider, and OIDC proof remain unproven

handoff.review_verify: cd /tmp/aithema-source-review && npm ci && npm test && npm run release:build
handoff.provenance_note: private_source_commit is original private lineage. current_source_commit is the Git commit actually exported. Runtime artifact manifests bind source.commit to current_source_commit under frozen schema 0.1. runtime_tree_digest uses the AIT-10 path+blob-sha inventory and is not a Git tree object id.
